appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4'.
X-axis label: 'Quarter'. Tick marks labeled Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4.
A single blue line connects data points for each quarter, showing an upward trend from Q1 to Q4.
The line starts at Q1, with a revenue value just above 1000 (approximately 1050).
The line rises to Q2, with a revenue value just below 1400 (approximately 1300).
The line rises to Q3, with a revenue value just above 1400 (approximately 1450).
The line ends at Q4, with a revenue value just below 1800 (approximately 1750).

public_definitions: Review the Company C revenue dashboard for the Q1-Q4 operations record, then choose the follow-up route for the revenue trend.
Use the Company C revenue dashboard as the evidence source for the revenue trend routing decision.
The primary field is 'Revenue trend route' with options: 'Route to revenue growth response', 'Route to revenue stability response', 'Route to revenue decline response'.
